Subject: MAP Kickoff — Handoff, Evaluation Owners, and Scheduling

Hi Ellen,

Thanks again for the call earlier today. We're excited to get the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) kickstarted so we can align on success criteria and hit your Q4 timeline. To keep momentum, proposed next steps below and a calendar hold for a 60-minute kickoff:

Proposed kickoff (calendar hold):
- When: Thu, Jun 10 · 10:00–11:00 AM PT (calendar invite attached)
- Where: Zoom (link below)

Draft agenda (60') — goal: agree owners, evaluation plan, and close milestones
1) Intros & objectives (5')
2) MAP walkthrough — milestones & owners (15')
3) Evaluation plan: datasets, success criteria, and access (20')
4) Integration & infra checklist (10')
5) Next steps / owners / immediate blockers (10')

Initial attendee suggestions (please confirm or update):
- Ellen Zhao — Product / Evaluation lead (Acme Health)
- Priya Desai — ML Ops (Acme Health)
- Jonas Weber — AE (Redwood)
- Karthik Iyer — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)
- Monica Patel — Customer Success (Redwood)

Attachments: RDW_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft), evaluation_checklist.xlsx (initial eval questions).
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=zoompwd
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Can you confirm the time and the attendee list? Also if there are any compliance/security folks who must attend for data access conversations, flag them so we can loop them in.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on owners so we can start the eval sprint next week.

Best,
Jonas Weber
